preferences.displayHelp: Configure what information to display in chat messages.
preferences.effortHelp: Default thinking budget for reasoning models. Models that don't offer the tier you pick fall back to their closest one (Qwen3.8, for example, only takes Low, Medium and X-High). Override it per session with the effort button next to the chat input, or per message by typing
preferences.modelHelp: Configure model parameters for API requests.
preferences.showReasoningHelp: Display the model's reasoning process when available (extended thinking models)
preferences.showStatisticsHelp: Display token usage, cost, and performance metrics for each response
preferences.systemPromptHelp: Applied to all chat sessions globally. Leave empty for no system prompt.
preferences.systemPromptPlaceholder: Enter a system prompt, or select a .txt / .md file below...
preferences.temperatureHelp: Controls randomness. Lower is more focused, higher is more creative (0-2, default: 0.7)
preferences.tokenNote: Token limits are managed by your API provider (OpenRouter). If you encounter token limit errors, you may need to upgrade your account or use a different model.
preferences.updateUrlHelp: Leave empty to disable automatic update checks
preferences.visualExplanationsHelp: Let the model illustrate explanations with diagrams (added before your system prompt)
